newsitem.title: PERU: Forty injured in Peru salsa festival fight.
newsitem.headline: Forty injured in Peru salsa festival fight.

text.p: Some 40 people were injured when quarrels broke out at an outdoor salsa festival in a poor barrio of the Peruvian capital, firefighters said.

They said most of the injured suffered cuts and bruises as people tried to flee from a packed street where groups of youths, some brandishing broken bottles, clashed for unclear reasons Sunday. No serious injuries or arrests were reported.
Salsa bands from the United States, Venezuela and Ecuador took part in the show, which continued despite the incidents.
